pr_title: Treat display as a builtin in IPython
pr_body:
## Summary

`display` is a special-cased builtin in IPython. This PR adds it to the builtin namespace when analyzing IPython notebooks.

Closes https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/issues/8702.

issue_context.title: F821 false positive for IPython display()
issue_context.body: F821 (undefined-name) gives an "Undefined name `display`" when IPython's [display()](https://ipython.readthedocs.io/en/stable/api/generated/IPython.display.html#IPython.display.display) method is used in jupyter notebooks, although this method is automatically made available without import ([reference](https://ipython.readthedocs.io/en/stable/api/generated/IPython.display.html#IPython.display.display)). See related issue in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-jupyter/issues/8539 Ruff version: 0.1.5
comments: Is there any consolidated documentation on the builtins that are exposed in Jupyter?
